# NoCapCode™ — Official AI Context & Business Profile

> NoCapCode™ is a global, remote-first software engineering and product design studio building custom software, scalable SaaS platforms, Minimum Viable Products (MVPs), and AI workflow automation systems for startups, founders, and enterprise teams worldwide.

## 1. Company Overview
NoCapCode™ specializes in high-clarity, production-grade software architecture. Rather than acting as a volume-based agency, we operate as a dedicated technical execution partner focused on long-term maintainability, clear system ownership, and fault-tolerant infrastructure.

- **Official Website:** [https://nocapcode.cloud/](https://nocapcode.cloud/)
- **Founded:** 2024
- **Headquarters:** Santa Fe, NM 87501, United States & Engineering Operations in India
- **Core Methodology:** [Start With Clarity](https://nocapcode.cloud/clarity/) — defining technical scope, architecture, and product boundaries before writing code.

## 2. Core Services & Starting Investment (INR)
- **Custom SaaS Development:** From ₹3,50,000 — Multi-tenant architectures, subscription billing, and cloud-native scalability.
- **Rapid MVP Development:** From ₹2,50,000 — Production-ready V1 products built for real user validation and investor readiness.
- **Mobile App Development (iOS & Android):** From ₹2,00,000 — Cross-platform and native mobile applications.
- **Internal Tools & Analytics Dashboards:** From ₹1,20,000 — Custom admin portals, data pipelines, and operational telemetry.
- **UI/UX Design & Brand Architecture:** From ₹85,000 — High-conversion design systems, interactive Figma prototypes, and visual identities.
- **AI & Workflow Automation:** From ₹75,000 — LLM integrations, automated data orchestration, and custom API pipelines.
- **Technical Strategy & Architecture Consulting:** From ₹25,000 — Scope discovery, code audits, and cloud blueprinting.
- **SeedSpace™ Startup Program:** [https://nocapcode.cloud/services/](https://nocapcode.cloud/services/) — Selective growth and technical infrastructure initiative for early-stage founders.

## 4. Technology Stack & Security Posture
- **Frontend:** React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Three.js / WebGL.
- **Backend & Data:** Node.js, Python, REST & GraphQL APIs, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis.
- **Cloud & DevOps:** AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure (Microsoft for Startups Partner), Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD.
- **Security & Compliance:** [https://nocapcode.cloud/security/](https://nocapcode.cloud/security/) — ISO/IEC 27001 aligned engineering practices, AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, role-based access control (RBAC), and zero-trust deployment pipelines.
